measures.title: Sales and Use Tax for Mental Health or Chemical Dependency Treatment or Therapeutic Courts
measures.what_it_does: Advisory vote: asks whether the county commissioners should adopt a 0.1% sales and use tax (RCW 82.14.460) for chemical dependency and mental health treatment and therapeutic courts. The vote does not itself impose the tax; the board may decide afterwards.
measures.cost_line: If the board later adopts it: 0.1% sales and use tax (one cent on a $10 purchase), county-wide.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Grant County Public Hospital District No. 4 (McKay Healthcare & Rehabilitation)
measures.title: Bonds for Expansion of McKay Healthcare & Rehabilitation Center
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes up to $9,940,000 of general obligation bonds, maturing within 30 years and repaid by an excess property tax levy, to add a 16-bed assisted living unit, a 16-bed memory care unit and other capital improvements at McKay Healthcare & Rehabilitation Center in Soap Lake.
measures.cost_line: Estimated $0.61 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $15.27 a month on a $300,000 home); up to $9,940,000 in bonds.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Public Safety Sales and Use Tax
measures.what_it_does: Raises the city's sales and use tax by 0.1% (RCW 82.14.450) for public safety: police staffing and retention, operations, maintenance and capital, and other criminal justice services.
measures.cost_line: 0.1% sales and use tax (one cent on a $10 purchase); about $1.2 million in 2027.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Grant County Fire Protection District No. 7
measures.title: Emergency Medical Service Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Replaces the last two years of the district's 2022 EMS levy (up to $0.25, suspended in 2024) with a six-year EMS levy first levied in 2026 for collection from 2027.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value (no more than $150 a year on a $300,000 home).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Grant County Cemetery District No. 2 (Wilson Creek)
measures.title: Special Levy for Maintenance and Operations
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes the cemetery district's yearly one-year special levy for maintenance and operations of the Wilson Creek cemetery, collected in 2027.
measures.cost_line: $12,000, approximately $0.18 per $1,000 of assessed value, collected in 2027.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
